<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks at 132.43, 130.27, 129.30, 126.70, 126.66, and 123.57 ppm fall within the typical aromatic carbon region (≈120–150 ppm). That gives six aromatic carbon signals. No other peaks correspond to aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
